### **Part II** &nbsp;&nbsp;Type of Change

> Place an **X** in **only one** box that best describes this Pull Request.

- [ ] **feat**: Introduces a new feature or capability to the codebase.
- [ ] **fix**: Patches a bug, resolves incorrect behavior, or addresses a defect.
- [ ] **refactor**: Updates or restructures existing code without changing external behavior (no new features, no bug fixes).
- [ ] **chore**: Routine maintenance tasks such as dependency updates, formating changes, tweaks, or repository cleanup.
- [ ] **docs**: Adds or updates documentation (README, examples, comments, or usage instructions).
- [ ] **other**: Any change that does not fit the categories above, provide additional context below.
